req.title: Update existing post
req.statement: The system shall update the row when POST /<id>/update is called by the post's author with a title and body, and redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /<id>/update by the post's author with valid title and body must update the DB row and return 302 to /. I need: (1) a positive EP test confirming the happy path updates the row and redirects to /; (2) a negative NEG test for a non-author attempting the update (403); (3) a BVA test using a single-character title (minimum valid boundary); (4) a DT test for missing title (empty string) which should NOT update and should flash an error; (5) a STC test confirming the state transition from pre-update to post-update values in the DB; (6) a NEG test for unauthenticated access (302 to login). All tests use pre-loaded data: post id=2 belongs to user id=1 (Rahul/stone), post id=7 belongs to user id=2 (Anjali/cloud).

tests.name: test_update_post_happy_path_redirects_and_persists
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with post id=2 authored by user id=1 (Rahul/stone)
actions: POST /2/update with title='Updated Title' and body='Updated body text'
expected: Database row for post id=2 has title='Updated Title' and body='Updated body text'
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated body text'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

with app.app_context():
    db = get_db()
    row = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 2').fetchone()
    assert row['title'] == 'Updated Title'
    assert row['body'] == 'Updated body text'

os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_update_post_max_length_title_and_body_accepted
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with post id=2 authored by user id=1 (Rahul/stone)
actions: POST /2/update with title of exactly 120 'X' chars and body of exactly 1000 'Y' chars
expected: Database row for post id=2 has title of length 120 and body of length 1000
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

long_title = 'X' * 120
long_body = 'Y' * 1000

r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': long_title, 'body': long_body})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

with app.app_context():
    db = get_db()
    row = db.execute('SELECT title, body FROM post WHERE id = 2').fetchone()
    assert row['title'] == long_title
    assert len(row['title']) == 120
    assert row['body'] == long_body
    assert len(row['body']) == 1000

os.unlink(path)
